scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/host build && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build
scripts.lint: eslint apps/desktop/src apps/host/src packages/contracts/src scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs scripts/remote-smoke.mjs apps/host/tests/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/host build && node --test apps/host/tests/host.integration.test.mjs apps/host/tests/daemon.integration.test.mjs
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test
